subject: Hummingbird private deployment — onboarding playlist & network handoff
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@hummingbird.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — private deployment options

Thanks Ben — excited to get this moving. A few quick clarifications from our side before the kickoff call: 

1) We want PrivateLink (AWS) for control-plane egress and a direct VPC peering for data-plane traffic (large batch ingestion). Can you confirm Redwood supports dual-path?
2) We need the on-prem package to run behind our edge proxy (NGINX) and support client cert auth; any docs you can share?
3) SOC2 evidence request: what specific logging events do you surface during tokenized inference?

Attaching our internal network diagram and a short questionnaire. Planning to have our infra lead, Martina Rojas, on the call Thursday.

—Carlos
Hummingbird AI

Attachments: hb-network-diagram-v1.pdf (diagram), hummingbird-infra-q1.xlsx (questionnaire)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@hummingbird.ai>, Hummingbird Ops <ops@hummingbird.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — private deployment options

Thanks Carlos — answered inline and added next steps. High level: yes, we can do the dual-path approach with PrivateLink for the control plane and VPC peering for your data subnet. We'll propose an implementation playlist so responsibilities are clear.

Quick answers:
- Dual-path support: confirmed. Control plane to Redwood console over AWS PrivateLink (managed endpoint). Data-plane: VPC peering between your data VPC and the Redwood dedicated VPC. We recommend keeping inference egress on the peered route to minimize latency.
- On-prem package behind edge proxy: our installer supports reverse proxy setups and mTLS client certs. There's a short checklist in the installer guide — I'll attach the trimmed-onprem checklist.
- Logging: we emit request start/stop, model selection, token counts, and sanitized error traces. For SOC2 you can request higher retention and audit-log exports (we provide S3 export or Customer-managed KMS for logs).

Proposed immediate next steps (playlist):
1) Thursday 10:00am PT — technical kickoff with infra + networking (you: Martina; us: Marissa + Monica).
2) Exchange VPC CIDR and preferred peer subnet ranges (Hummingbird ops).
3) Redwood to share PrivateLink ARNs and required service principals.
4) Hummingbird to provision a CIDR for the peering and open control-plane egress to Redwood IPs for initial staging.
5) Post-kickoff: submit access request to our deployment queue with the attached onprem checklist and signed MSA.

I'll add the meeting invite and a short runbook in the Drive link.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-onprem-checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@hummingbird.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Sep 2028 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — private deployment options

Looping in some implementation detail here so the kickoff can be tactical. A few items I want on the kickoff agenda (15–20 minute blockers):

- CIDR overlap: we need both your VPC and any on-prem ranges. If overlapping, we recommend NAT + routed appliance.
- Private endpoints: we'll provide a PrivateLink service and the ARN; we need your account ID and a contact who can accept the endpoint.
- Firewall rules: list of ports (6400-6420 for internal RPC, 443 for control plane, 22 for maintenance if enabled).
- Installer mode: staging vs air-gapped. If you plan air-gap, bring the appliance image + offline license token procedures.
- KMS/HSM: confirm if you want Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed (we support AWS KMS + HSM integrations).

Action items before call: Carlos, please drop the Martina R.'s contact and the preferred CIDR ranges into the Drive folder. Monica and I will draft the runbook sections we own.

—Marissa
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@hummingbird.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hummingbird Ops <ops@hummingbird.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Sep 2028 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — private deployment options

Thanks Marissa — Martina Rojas (martina.rojas@hummingbird.ai) will join. Current CIDRs: 10.10.0.0/16 (control plane staging), 172.16.32.0/20 (data ingestion). Martina will also share the edge proxy config and the team can accept the PrivateLink.

One more ask: for the on-prem package, we need a short checklist of registry/OCI settings to preload images into our disconnected registry. Can Redwood provide the tarball names and expected repository paths?

—Carlos

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@hummingbird.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, contracts@hummingbird.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Sep 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — private deployment options

Great cadence — recap and owners below. Also attaching the signed MSA stub for reference (please confirm receipt, Carlos).

Recap (owners & deadlines):
- Meeting: Thursday 10:00am PT — technical kickoff (owner: Ben)
- PrivateLink ARNs & service principals: Redwood (Marissa) — due EOD Wednesday 2028-10-03
- Peering CIDR confirmation: Hummingbird (Carlos/Martina) — due Mon 2028-10-01
- On-prem OCI preload manifest (tarball names & repo paths): Redwood (Monica) — due Tue 2028-10-02
- SOC2 logging export template: Redwood (Marissa) — due Tue 2028-10-02

Attachments referenced: hb-signed-ms-cta.pdf (signed MSA), redwood-onprem-checklist.xlsx (installer checklist)

Notes on installer variants:
- Staging installer: will fetch images from Redwood registry over peered path; requires outbound egress to our artifact mirror (we'll provide CIDRs).
- Air-gapped installer: produce OCI tarballs and an offline license token. We will provide exact image names: redwood/runtime:v3.4.1, redwood/edge-agent:v2.1.0, redwood/sidecar-logger:v1.2.

Carlos — please confirm receipt of the MSA and the Thursday time. If that time doesn't work, propose an alternate and Ben will reschedule.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Attachments: hb-signed-ms-cta.pdf, redwood-onprem-checklist.xlsx
